subject: general
question:
Seven people, I, J, K, L, P, Q and R are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of R. Only three people sit between R and L. I sits second to the right of R. Only two people sit between I and Q. K sits at some place to the right of J but at some place to the left of P.

How many people sit to the right of K?
solution:
Seven people, I, J, K, L, P, Q, and R, are sitting in a row, facing north.

 
• Only two people sit to the left of R.
 
• Only three people sit between R and L.
 
• I sits second to the right of R.
 
• Only two people sit between I and Q.
 
• K sits at some place to the right of J but at some place to the left of P

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51fcbfb2d8b651b11829c035fc51b03fc040de26476f6443db415e38f9e36dba.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
